# Copilot Instructions — studylife-mcp

The binding rules for this repository live in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) in the repository
root. Read that file and follow it; nothing here overrides it.

This file previously held a condensed summary of those rules, introduced as a convenience.
It drifted: it described Home Assistant tools and a milestone range that `CLAUDE.md` had
already declared out of scope, so the two disagreed on what the project even is. A pointer
cannot go stale.
